observations.observed: Direct workspace .ts/.mts/.cts targets return PROVEN under pinned native strip-only grammar with compiled UNAVAILABLE. A workspace-local tsconfig and a divergent dist counterpart are not inputs when runtime export explicitly selects .ts.
observations.assessment: Not counted as a demonstrated false semantic proof: actual selected runtime path is the .ts source, no emit substitution was observed, and preserved0236tests explicitly allow direct TS source under the pinned runtime. These probes do not establish the required negative for TS without a demonstrated execution/emit profile. Lead must retain that RS08 negative in qualification and distinguish direct native-TS from unproven emit/browser execution; do not infer emit correctness from these positives.

observations.assessment: No analyzer-owned descriptor leak established. Coarse total fd counts alone are not treated as proof of a leak or of universal cleanup.
